structural_change: gate r1 (unsubmitted): one clk root over two opposite 388.8-um pin faces measured TT all-sink insertion 335..474 ps (spread 139 > 80; the xcal r1 analogue routed to boundary spread 109 and failed native capture). r2: three related phase-0 roots (same pll_stream), each with its boundary sinks along ONE face: clk_in = W input pin flops (rv/rrow/rdata/faults), clk_out = E wq output flops, clk = collar/descriptor/FIFO core with the N F20 face; balanced sink clustering. rdata/wq split into _lo/_hi ports so each face clock entry sits at its face centre.
